name: Guillotine 2099

abilityDetails.Degeneration: Rakibe zamanla doğrudan, engellenemez hasar verir.
abilityDetails.Armor Up: Zırh değerini artırarak alınan fiziksel hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Pre-Fight: Dövüş başlamadan önce Pre-Fight ekranından değiştirilebilen yetenek.
abilityDetails.Guaranteed Crits: Tüm vuruşlar garanti kritik vuruş olur.
abilityDetails.Power Burn: Hedeften belirli miktarda güç alır, ardından alınan güçle orantılı doğrudan hasar verir.

howToPlay: Guillotine 2099 için oynanış rehberi: Özel saldırılarını kullanarak rakiplerini alt edin. Komboları düzgün zamanlayarak siper alın.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Tech sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Advanced A.i. Integration
When Guillotine would be struck, she has a [5 - 100]% chance to gain a Combo Shield Passive lasting 2 seconds, plus 2 additional seconds per Digi-Soul. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
While under the effect of a Combo Shield, damage from incoming attacks excluding Special 3 is capped at 10% of Guillotine's max health.

abilitySections.title: Robotics
content: Advanced Robotics provides Immunity to Bleed & Poison effects.

Once per fight, when Guillotine drops below 15% health and she has at least 1 Digi-Soul, Self-Repair is activated, recovering [18,073.8] health per Digi-Soul over 4 seconds. This ability triggers instantly when starting a fight below 15% health. If Stunned during repair, connection is lost and the Repair immediately ends.

abilitySections.title: Basic Attacks
content: Guillotine can't land Critical Hits naturally, however all Basic Attacks that aren't Critical, have a chance based on Critical Rating to inflict a Degeneration Debuff dealing [2,762] direct damage over 3 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Digi-Souls - Persistent Charge
content: Guillotine begins the quest with 2 Digi-Souls, each providing +16% Defensive Combat Power Rate. Digi-Souls are refunded after each fight and can be spent to enhance Guillotine's sword on the Pre-Fight screen.

At the start of the fight if Guillotine has at least 1 Digi-Soul, she gains an Armor Up Buff granting +[1,833.33] Armor Rating per Digi-Soul and lasting indefinitely. If removed, this Armor reactivates after 4 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Pre-Fight - Sword Empowerment- Costs 1 Digi-Soul each.
content: Huntress Function: Every 20th attack on the Combo Meter is a guaranteed Critical Hit, if this Attack is a Special 1 or 2 all hits of the Attack are guaranteed to be Critical.
Stability Function: While above 99 hits in the Combo Meter, Medium attacks Regenerate 5% of the damage dealt.
Assault Function: While above 99 hits in the Combo Meter, Medium attacks Burn 5% of the Opponent's Current Power.

abilitySections.title: Heavy Attacks
content: 100% chance to gain a Combo Shield Passive lasting indefinitely. Max stacks 2, plus an additional 2 for every Digi-Soul. When struck, a Combo Shield is removed.

abilitySections.title: Passive - Combo Meter Abilities
content: Guillotine's Attack Rating increases by +[165.72] with each hit in her Combo Meter, capping after 100 hits.
At a Combo of 100+ Guillotine's sword becomes empowered, dealing a burst of [220.96] Energy Damage for each hit above 100, scaling with base attack and capping after 600 hits.

abilitySections.title: When Attacked by a Light or Medium Attack
content: 15% chance to activate Digi-Cloak, lasting 2.5 seconds per Digi-Soul and causing all unblocked attacks to Miss. Cooldown: 10 seconds after each use, and each time Guillotine is knocked down.
While fighting Mutant Opponents, the Digi-Cloak's cooldown is reduced by 50%, and it's chance to activate is doubled.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final strike of this attack drains 20% of the Opponent's current Power per Digi-Soul, increasing to 40% per Digi-Soul if the attack doesn't make contact with the Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: On activation: 100% chance to inflict a Spectre Debuff, reducing the Opponent's Regeneration Rate by 120% for 12 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: If the Opponent is at or below 5% of their max health this attack knocks them out. This damage can be prevented or reduced.
If Guillotine uses this attack to knock out her Opponent, their soul is digitized and absorbed, allowing her to start the next fight with 100 hits in her Combo Meter.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Advanced A.i. Integration
content: When Guillotine would be struck, she has a [5 - 100]% chance to gain a Combo Shield Passive lasting 2 seconds, plus 2 additional seconds per Digi-Soul. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
While under the effect of a Combo Shield, damage from incoming attacks excluding Special 3 is capped at 10% of Guillotine's max health.
